name: Cave Bear
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A hulking cave bear with coarse dark brown fur, a broad domed head, heavy shoulders, and broad paws.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (2014), Appendix A, p. 334, Polar Bear and Variant: Cave Bear. https://online.anyflip.com/pqhqn/sezy/files/basic-html/page335.html
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. Gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. +7 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Claws. +7 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
sections.Variant rules: The Cave Bear sidebar adds darkvision 60 ft. to the Polar Bear on the same folio. Carry over its other statistics, including its 30-ft. swim speed.

name: Diseased Giant Rat
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A large brown-gray rat with a coarse coat, rounded ears, pink feet, and a long bare tail.

sections.Printed source:
Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (2014), Appendix A, p. 327, Giant Rat and Variant: Diseased Giant Rats. https://online.anyflip.com/pqhqn/sezy/files/basic-html/page328.html
The Bite attack uses the published errata.
sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. Gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Pack Tactics. Gain advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally of the rat is within 5 ft. of the target and is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. +4 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or contract the disease. While the disease persists, the creature can recover HP only by magic and loses 3 (1d6) from its HP maximum every 24 hours. It dies if that reduction brings its HP maximum to 0.
sections.Variant rules: Keep the Giant Rat’s statistics and traits. Use the sidebar’s replacement Bite with the errata’s attack and damage numbers.

name: Giant Lizard (Hold Breath and Spider Climb)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 10. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A low-slung olive and gold lizard with splayed climbing toes, a finely scaled hide, and a long tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (2014), Appendix A, p. 326, Giant Lizard and Variant: Giant Lizard Traits. https://online.anyflip.com/pqhqn/sezy/files/basic-html/page327.html
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. A lizard with this trait can hold its breath for 15 minutes and swim 30 ft.
Spider Climb. A lizard with this trait can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings upside down, without making an ability check.
sections.Actions: Bite. +4 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Variant rules: This existing named scope uses both sidebar traits. Hold Breath adds a 30-ft. swim speed. Spider Climb retains the 30-ft. climb speed and removes the ability check on difficult surfaces.

name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
otherStatistics: Perception +3 and Stealth +6. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A stocky tawny cat with spotted shoulders, heavy forepaws, a short tail, and long curved upper canines.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (2014), Appendix A, p. 336, Saber-Toothed Tiger. https://online.anyflip.com/pqhqn/sezy/files/basic-html/page337.html
sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. Gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Pounce. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature, a Claw hit against it that turn forces a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure the target falls prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one Bite against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. +6 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.
Claw. +6 to hit in melee, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
